verdict.rationale: Docs confirm up to 64GB unified memory and 273GB/s bandwidth (apple-m4-pro-docs-12), which theoretically could host a quantized 70B model, and community discussion references using Pro/Max chips for local LLMs (apple-m4-pro-comm-5). However, no benchmark or hands-on evidence in the pack confirms actual 70B-class inference speed or practicality, and the bandwidth is notably lower than Apple's own Max/Ultra tiers, which are the parts community discourse (comm-7) implies would be preferred for heavier local LLM workloads. Missing for 10: concrete tokens/sec benchmarks for 70B quantized models on M4 Pro, explicit statements about running 70B model without OOM/context tradeoffs, independent hands-on inference reports.
